data.name: Dhannjay
data.gender_notes: Dhannjay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Dhan’ (wealth, prosperity) and ‘Jaya’ (victory). This name is associated with the deity Dhanvantari, the god of medicine and wealth, and symbolizes the attainment of both material and spiritual wealth. The name Dhannjay carries the meaning “God's wealth, prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhannjay usually hope their child will grow to embody god's wealth, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessed with divine wealth and prosperity
data.etymology: Dhannjay belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's wealth, prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhannjay total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_sanskrit.name: धन्नजय
in_sanskrit.meaning: धन्न (Dhanan) - God of wealth, prosperity and abundance, जय (Jaya) - Victory
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings victory through wealth and prosperity. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'धनन्' (Dhanan), which means 'God of wealth, prosperity and abundance'. The suffix 'जय' (Jaya) is added to denote victory.
